transformations.edit: Extracted the target-local ArrayWindows representation with the private `v` field, preserving field name, order, type, and privacy while omitting Rust stability/doc attributes.
Included ArrayWindows::new with the real Rust body `Self { v: slice }` so the target call is verified rather than trusted.
Adapted the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter and named return for Verus; the executable body remains assert then ArrayWindows::new(slice).
Converted Rust `assert!(N != 0, ...)` to Verus `assert(N != 0)` under the same generated precondition; no control-flow path is removed.
Defined the closed iterator-view helper from the extracted `v` field to expose source, remaining, empty yielded prefix/remainder, chunk size N, and forward direction.
Revealed the closed iterator-view definition in ghost proof blocks; this has no executable data-flow or evaluation-order effect.
